comment: WAV is listed as subtracts, but the floor is an accident rather than a design. Autobreak.hpp:129 stores the knob-plus-CV total in an unsigned int and only clamps it at Autobreak.hpp:130, after the conversion. Converting a negative float to an unsigned int is undefined behaviour in C++; on the arm64 build it saturates at 0, which is why a negative CV pulls the selection down to the first sample and stops there rather than wrapping.
